locked_semantics: For an elliptic curve over Q, ellrank returns [r1,r2,s,L] with r1 <= rank(E(Q)) <= r2 unconditionally.
The routine performs 2-descent and computes the 2-part of Cassels pairings; r2 is an unconditional upper bound, not a BSD estimate.
effort=0 avoids the randomized extra point search used for positive effort values.

decision_rule.purpose: Decide whether model 6 can be a rank-zero quotient target; a non-singleton interval with positive lower bound is enough to exclude rank zero but is not exact-rank credit.

credit: PARI interval credit is limited to the locked inequalities. It may decide zero versus nonzero rank, and it gives exact rank only when the returned interval is a singleton. It does not enumerate quotient-torsor rational points and does not close a parent branch.
